items.q: What is the mass of 12 litres of sea water in kg?
items.reply: The mass is about 12.3 kg (m = ρ·V = 1025 kg/m³ × 0.012 m³ for seawater; ρ is a typical value near 20 °C). [densities-r2]

items.q: What does that weigh in newtons?
items.reply: The weight is about 120.6 N (W = m·g = 12.3 kg × 9.80665 m/s², standard Earth gravity).
